blueprint.desc: Game-owned ballistic flight and scoring from your actual position; free movement and camera, including third person. Count Up, 301, 501 and Cricket; 1–4 players. E: play, Space: start/throw/next, Q/Z: power, M: mode, R: reset, Esc: exit, X: leave.
